summary: Treat readonly parameter property as compile-time restriction, not frozen JS property.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

semantics.runtime: ordinary writable property under standard emit

tests.name: mutate any
tests.input: class C { constructor(readonly x:number){} }; const c=new C(1); (c as any).x=2; console.log(c.x);

tests.name: init
tests.input: class C { constructor(readonly x:number){} }; console.log(new C(5).x);
